description: Use this when the user asks what a dental procedure costs in a given US state (51 incl. DC), or how a state sits next to the US average, for one of 12 procedures: exam and cleaning, filling, deep cleaning, extraction, root canal, crown, implant, All-on-4, dentures, braces, veneer, whitening. Returns the state cash band (low / average / high) in US dollars, the national band, the gap in percent and the state's Restorative Cost Index. For crown, veneer, braces and dentures it returns no state figure: those per-state figures (ASQ360/CareCredit Average Procedural Cost Study 2023-2024) are cited on realdentalcosts.com pages but not licensed for redistribution, so the answer gives status no_source_at_this_level, the study link and the national band. Each figure is labelled observed or estimated, with a note naming the study behind it and its period (implants from Real Dental Costs' editorial estimate, edition 2026.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20531728, not collected data, state ranking validated against ASQ360, levels not verified; other procedures scaled from the national figure and marked estimated), so the answer can say where the state number comes from and how old it is. Phrasings: "how much is a filling in Ohio without insurance", "what do people in Florida pay for a root canal", "¿cuánto cuesta un implante dental en Texas?", "costo de una limpieza dental en California". When the user already has an amount quoted by their dentist and asks whether it is normal, use benchmark_treatment_plan instead: it places the quoted amount against this band line by line. Do not use for: diagnosis, treatment choice, a named insurer's plan price, dentist recommendations, countries other than the US and Canada. Market research and public program data with a source URL and period on every figure; not a quote, not medical advice.

procedure.description: Procedure id. One of: exam (Exam, cleaning & X-rays), filling (Composite filling (1 tooth)), deepclean (Deep cleaning (SRP, per quadrant)), extraction (Tooth extraction), rootcanal (Root canal), allon4 (All-on-4 (per arch)), whitening (Professional teeth whitening), crown (Dental crown), veneer (Porcelain veneer (per tooth)), braces (Braces (traditional, full case)), implant (Single dental implant (complete)), dentures (Full set of dentures (both arches)).

quoted_usd.description: Optional amount quoted to the user for this procedure, in US dollars, in the unit of the procedure label (per tooth, per arch, full set): returns its position in the state band.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (or DC). One of: AL, AR, MS, KY, WV, IA, KS, OK, IN, SD, LA, NE, SC, GA, MO, TN, ND, OH, NC, MI, NM, WI, UT, ID, MN, TX, WY, AZ, FL, MT, CO, VA, IL, ME, PA, CT, OR, VT, DE, NV, RI, MD, WA, NH, NJ, MA, DC, AK, HI, NY, CA.
